name: All-season Washer Solvent

features.text: Dissolves road film, dirt and bugs.
Prevents reservoirs and washer-fluid lines from freezing and breaking.
Will not harm car finishes, paint, metal, or rubber.

description: Quickly removes road film, mud and bugs from the windshield. It leaves no streaks or smears and will not harm car finish, paint, metal or rubber. All-Season Washer Solvent™ is designed to protect against the freezing and cracking of washer fluid lines and reservoirs. This product protects to below zero degrees Fahrenheit. NOT FOR SALE IN CALIFORNIA
application: Add contents to washer reservoir. Fill reservoir with proper amount of water: 1 part All-Season Washer Solvent™ to 4 parts water (protects down to 0°F) or 1 part All-Season Washer Solvent™ to 8 parts water (protects down to 20°F) in warmer climates; 1 part All- Season Washer Solvent™ to 15 parts or up to one gallon of water may be added.
